{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Neuro Runner''' was a fast enemy that appeared relatively early on in [[Failed Gateway]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It also appeared in [[Containment]], though only when summoned by [[Corrupted Titus]]. It had a fair amount of health for its debut, high defense and a fast speed, making it a dangerous enemy to unprepared defenses. Additionally, it had [[Freeze Immunity]], making it immune to being chilled or frozen, and [[Stun Immunity]], making it immune to being stunned, and instead being slowed down. ==Appearance== The '''Neuro Runner''' was a wooden construct with a brown body, though the ends of its legs were made out of metal scraps. It had dark brown shirt and pants, alongside even darker gloves. It also had multiple dark brown bandages around its gloves. It wore multiple pieces of grey metal armor, knee-pads, armbands, chestplate and armor around the gloves, with some of them having spikes. On its back, it had an energy pack which lead to an energy core located on its chestplate, which gave it its speed. It also had a metal head piece with wires and a lens on its head and a grey metal face mask. ==Strategy== *The '''Neuro Runner''' can be defeated using stronger towers like the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Soldier]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Brawler]]. **These also often spawn in groups, accompanied by multiple [[Aggro]] enemies. Having some towers in the back may be needed in cases where [[Aggro]] enemies make '''Neuro Runners''' run out of your tower's ranges. *The '''Neuro Runner''' is immune to being slowed down by freezing towers or frozen by them and can only be slowed down by the stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]], making it harder to slow down. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] is not affected by any of its immunities and has a pretty long poison time and quite cheap to afford, making it a decent option, especially when set to ''Random'' to slow down as many as possible. ***It can also be pretty effective at dealing damage. **As [[Stun Immunity]] also prevents enemies from being knocked back, towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot be used to slow it down. *Its defense can be reduced by towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Trapper]], however, it cannot be reduced by the freezing towers due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png|'''Neuro Runner''' on the game thumbnail. TheHauntThumbnail.png|'''Neuro Runner''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HexscapePI1.jpg|'''Neuro Runner''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Video}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Neuro Runner''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} HexscapeDiscordThumbnail.png|'''Neuro Runner''' on a render. }} ==Update History== *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Neuro Runner''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Neuro Runner's''' defense. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Neuro Runner's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Neuro Runner''' removed. {{FailedGateway|[[Brain Bound]]|Wave 2|Neuro Runner|Wave 5|[[Mind Shackled]]|Wave 6}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Containment]]
